class.name: VoxelShape3D
class.brief_description: A voxel-aware 3D collision shape backed by [VoxelShapeData].
class.description: Adapts a [VoxelShapeData] resource to the custom shape type implemented by the VoxelPhysics3D backend. Assign this resource to a [CollisionShape3D]. Changes to the shared voxel data are forwarded to the physics server automatically. Voxel [code](0, 0, 0)[/code] begins at the collision node's origin. The full bounds extend from zero to [member VoxelShapeData.dimensions] multiplied by [member VoxelShapeData.voxel_size]. Editor debug geometry shows these bounds rather than drawing every occupied voxel. [b]Note:[/b] This shape requires an engine build with the [code]voxel_physics_3d[/code] module and the VoxelPhysics3D backend.

method.name: get_voxel_data
method.description: Returns the voxel resource used for collision.

method.name: set_voxel_data
method.description: Assigns the voxel resource and updates the physics-server shape. Later changes to the resource also update the shape.

members.member: The occupancy, dimensions, voxel scale, and optional feature proxies used by this collision shape.
